description:
## Goal

Repair the draft stack so every pull request, branch, commit, and closed ticket name the same atomic change before fz-5xp.30 is reworked. The current #148 misleadingly contains fz-5xp.30, fz-kdt.22, and fz-tfn.67 while its title/body describe only .30.

## Verified starting state

#148 currently has exact ancestry `b3204097 -> 0d328303 (fz-5xp.30) -> 6ee0b86 (fz-kdt.22) -> b9d1630 (fz-tfn.67)`. PR #151 is merged. The actual live trunk is now `origin/main` at `de95e24`, containing #151 plus a later independent README commit. The uncommitted fz-tfn.62 candidate remains frozen in its own worktree and is not part of this ticket.

#148 is the top of existing remote stack #130: `main -> #128 -> #129 -> #131…#139 -> #147 -> #148`. The user-directed plan preserves this stack: rebase and push #128 onto `origin/main`, then rebase and push each descendant in order. Before beginning each push, check its immediate parent CI; while it runs, locally prepare only its immediate child. No broad unstack, branch/PR deletion, or base bypass is authorized in this ticket.

## Correct model

One ticket has one commit and one reviewable PR. Preserve the existing lower stack as its individual layers replay onto the current parent. At #148, retain only the rebased fz-5xp.30 commit, so #148 becomes a truthful one-ticket PR. Then replay fz-kdt.22 on #148 and fz-tfn.67 on .22, create their draft PRs as direct descendants, and append them to #130 with `gh stack`. Each title and ELI5 body must describe only its one commit.

The stale #129 relation remains a normal lower-stack edge while its parent chain is replayed; it is not authority for `.30` semantics. Do not close or delete any old PR/branch here. Do not rewrite main, delete a worktree, or lose the frozen .62 candidate.

## Acceptance

- Record old and new commit/PR graphs; prove each retained commit remains reachable with an equivalent patch.
- Replay #128 through #147 sequentially onto its immediate newly pushed parent, beginning at `origin/main`; each branch remains one reviewable ticket layer and each parent edge is exact.
- At the top, replay exactly one commit for #148, then create .22 and .67 as one-commit direct descendants; resolve conflicts semantically and run proportionate validation.
- #148 no longer contains `.22` or `.67`; every PR in the extended stack has a truthful ticket title/body.
- `gh stack` topology, direct-parent merge bases, PR commit lists, clean worktrees, diff/range equivalence, and CI state are recorded.
- The frozen .62 worktree fingerprint is unchanged.
- No source implementation changes, temporary compatibility commits, broad unstack, or hidden force-push fallout remain.

## Causality

This ticket blocks the reopened fz-5xp.30 contract cutover. That cutover blocks fz-tfn.62 and therefore the dependent tfn chain.

## Review

A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review must check graph membership, PR boundaries, parent sequencing, branch bases, and that no frozen worktree content was lost before close.
title: Rebuild #148 as a truthful stack before the intrinsic cutover
